80	### POST /v2/abort `{runId}` → kills that run's process tree.
81	### GET  /v2/runs → active runs. GET /health → add `version`, `claudeVersion`, `authMode`.
82	### Preview process manager
83	- `POST /v2/preview/start {projectSlug, port, command?}` → runs `command` (default: detect — `npm run dev`
84	  with `PORT`/`HOST=0.0.0.0`/`BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/`, or `npx serve -l <port>` for static) detached, logs captured.
85	- `POST /v2/preview/stop {projectSlug}`, `GET /v2/preview/status?projectSlug=` → `{running, port, pid, logTail}`.
86	- Claude itself may also start servers on its assigned port via Bash; appendSystemPrompt (built by app) tells it:
87	  project dir, preview port, base path `/preview/<slug>/`, bind 0.0.0.0.
88	
89	### Firewall
90	`FIREWALL_MODE=open` (default for this deployment): allow all public internet egress (npm, pip, git, web),
91	DROP egress to RFC1918/link-local/metadata (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254/16, 100.64/10) except DNS
92	resolvers. `FIREWALL_MODE=allowlist` keeps original behaviour. IPv6: allow global unicast only in open mode or drop.
93	
94	Auth: `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (from `claude setup-token`, long-lived) OR `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Pass through.
95	Claude Code version: latest `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` at build time (build arg overridable).
96	Image also includes: git, python3, pip, build-essential, ripgrep, common dev tooling so Claude can "set up applications".
97	
98	## 4. whisper (on-box speech-to-text)
99	`POST /transcribe` multipart field `audio` (webm/ogg/wav/mp3 from MediaRecorder) → `{text, language, durationMs}`.
100	Implementation: whisper.cpp server (or faster-whisper) with model `base.en`/`small` multilingual (pick for CPU speed:
101	target < 3 s for 10 s of audio on 4 vCPU). ffmpeg conversion inside container. Model files baked in or cached in data/whisper-models.
102	Internal only; app proxies `POST /api/transcribe`.
103	
104	## 5. app (server/ — Node 22, TypeScript, Fastify, @fastify/websocket, better-sqlite3, zod, argon2)
105	Serves built SPA from `web/dist` and all APIs under `/api`. Single multi-stage Dockerfile at repo root `Dockerfile.app`
106	builds web + server.
107	
108	### Auth & users
109	- Email+password (argon2id), httpOnly secure SameSite=Lax session cookie (`nx_sid`), CSRF via SameSite + `X-Requested-With`.
110	- Roles: `admin`, `member`. Per-project membership with permission level: `owner|editor|viewer`
111	  (viewer: read chat/files/preview; editor: prompt + edit files + preview control; owner: + manage members/delete).
112	  Admins see everything.
113	- Bootstrap admin from env on first start. Admin can create/disable users, reset passwords, set per-user limits
114	  (daily token budget, allowed models, allowed modes).
115	- Login rate limiting + lockout; all requests logged with client IP (Caddy `X-Forwarded-For`, trust only 127.0.0.1).
116	- Admin IP rules: allowlist/blocklist CIDRs (if allowlist non-empty, only those IPs may access; admins can never lock
117	  themselves out from the IP they set it from — warn).
118	
119	### Data model (SQLite, WAL)
120	users, sessions, projects(id, slug, name, description, color, icon, previewPort, previewCommand, links JSON, createdAt,
121	archived), project_members, conversations(id, projectId, title, claudeSessionId, model, mode, createdBy),
122	messages(id, conversationId, role user|assistant, content, attachments JSON, runId, createdAt),
123	runs(id, conversationId, userId, status queued|running|done|error|aborted, model, mode, startedAt, endedAt,
124	inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheRead, cacheWrite, costUsd, durationMs, ip),
125	run_events(runId, seq, type, data JSON) — full normalized event log (replay + "thinking" history),
126	uploads(id, userId, projectId, filename, mime, size, path, createdAt), audit_log(id, userId, ip, action, target, meta, ts),
127	request_log(ts, ip, userId, method, path, status, ms) (sampled/trimmed to 30 days), ip_rules, settings(key, value).
128	
129	### REST (JSON; errors `{error:{code,message}}`)
130	- `POST /api/auth/login|logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`, `POST /api/auth/password`
131	- `GET/POST /api/projects`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/projects/:id`, `GET/PUT /api/projects/:id/members`
132	- `GET /api/projects/graph` → `{nodes:[{id,slug,name,color,icon,status:'idle'|'running'|'error',activity:0..1,lastActiveAt}], links:[{source,target,kind}]}`
133	  links = user-defined relations + shared-member affinity; plus a central "core" node id `core`.
134	- `GET/POST /api/projects/:id/conversations`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/conversations/:id`,
135	  `GET /api/conversations/:id/messages` (with runs + events for assistant messages)
136	- `POST /api/conversations/:id/prompt {text, attachments:[uploadId], model, mode, thinking}` → `{runId, messageId}`
137	- `POST /api/runs/:id/abort`
138	- `POST /api/uploads` (multipart, max 50 MB/file, any type; images get thumbnails) → `{id, filename, mime, size, url}`;
139	  `GET /api/uploads/:id` (auth-checked)
140	- `POST /api/transcribe` (multipart audio) → `{text}`
141	- Files (scoped to /data/projects/<slug>, path traversal-safe, ignore node_modules/.git in tree):
142	  `GET /api/projects/:id/files/tree`, `GET /api/projects/:id/files/content?path=`, `PUT ... {path, content}`,
143	  `POST /api/projects/:id/files/rename|delete|mkdir`, `GET /api/projects/:id/files/download?path=` (zip for dirs)
144	- Preview: `POST /api/projects/:id/preview/start|stop`, `GET /api/projects/:id/preview/status`
145	- `GET /api/usage/me` → today/7d/30d tokens, cost, runs, by model; plus limits
146	- `GET /api/models` → `[{id:'opus',label:'Opus 5.5'},{id:'sonnet',label:'Sonnet 5.5'},{id:'haiku',label:'Haiku 4.5'}]` (admin-configurable)
147	- Admin (`/api/admin/*`, admin only): `overview` (KPIs: active users, runs today, tokens today, cost, error rate,
148	  active runs, req/min), `timeseries?metric=tokens|runs|requests|cost&range=24h|7d|30d&groupBy=user|project|model`,
149	  `users` CRUD, `users/:id/projects` grants, `prompts?userId&projectId&q&cursor` (full prompt log incl attachments),
150	  `activity` (audit log), `traffic` (requests by IP/path/status, top IPs, geo not required), `ip-rules` CRUD,
151	  `runs/active` + abort any, `settings` (models list, default model, global daily token cap, claude auth token update →
152	  writes .env value & restarts claudebox via docker socket is NOT allowed; instead store in settings and pass token per run
153	  as env `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` in /v2/run body field `authToken` — claudebox uses body token over env if present).
154	
155	### Live channel: WebSocket `GET /ws` (cookie auth)
156	Client → server: `{t:'sub', runId}`, `{t:'unsub', runId}`, `{t:'sub_project', projectId}`, `{t:'ping'}`.
157	Server → client:
158	- `{t:'run_event', runId, seq, type, data}` (normalized events above, persisted first, replay from `fromSeq` on sub)
159	- `{t:'run_status', runId, conversationId, projectId, status}`
160	- `{t:'file_change', projectId, path, kind:'add'|'change'|'unlink'|'addDir'|'unlinkDir'}` (chokidar, debounced 150 ms)
161	- `{t:'preview_status', projectId, running, port}`
162	- `{t:'graph_pulse', projectId, intensity}` (drives the spider-web animation)
163	- `{t:'suggestions', runId, items:[{label, prompt, kind:'next'|'fix'|'test'|'deploy'|'explain'}]}`
164	Runs continue server-side if the browser disconnects; reconnect + `sub` replays.
165	
166	### Actionable suggestions
167	appendSystemPrompt (built per run) instructs Claude to end every final reply with
168	`<nx-suggestions>[{"label":"…","prompt":"…","kind":"next"}]</nx-suggestions>` (2–4 items). Server strips that block
169	from the displayed text, validates JSON, emits `suggestions`, stores on the message.
170	Also includes project context: name, description, cwd, preview port, preview URL path `/preview/<slug>/`, "bind 0.0.0.0",
171	"use the assigned port", "you have internet access", "keep a README.md".
172	
173	### Preview proxy
174	`/preview/<slug>/*` (HTTP + WebSocket upgrade for HMR) → `http://claudebox:<previewPort>/preview/<slug>/*`
175	(do NOT strip the prefix; apps are told to use that base path. Also support `?strip=1` project setting to strip prefix
176	for apps that can't set a base). Auth: session cookie + project viewer permission. Set
177	`Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'` on the app and previews.
178	
179	## 6. web/ (React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + zustand + lucide-react + recharts + Monaco)
180	EVERYTHING bundled locally (Monaco via `loader.config({ monaco })` from the `monaco-editor` package — never the CDN;
181	fonts self-hosted via @fontsource: "JetBrains Mono" + "Space Grotesk" or "Rajdhani"/"Orbitron" for headings).
182	
183	Palette (CSS vars): bg `#07050a`, panel `#0f0a12`, panel-2 `#160e1a`, border `#2a1626`, text `#f6e9f0`, muted `#a68a99`,
184	pink `#ff3e8a`, hot-pink `#ff6fae`, warm `#ff8a5c` (accent 2), violet `#b14bff` (sparingly), success `#3dffb5`,
185	warn `#ffc857`, danger `#ff4d6d`. Subtle scanlines/grid, glows on focus, no garish overload.
186

217	## 7. Conventions
218	- TypeScript strict everywhere. No external network calls at runtime from browser.
219	- Shared types: `server/src/shared/protocol.ts` is the source of truth for WS + run events; web imports a copy
220	  (`web/src/shared/protocol.ts`, kept identical).
221	- Ports/hosts via env. Logs JSON to stdout.
222	- Don't commit secrets. `.env.example` documents vars.
223	# claudebox v2 protocol (Nxeon fork)
224	
225	This document describes the `/v2/*` API that the Nxeon `app` uses to drive Claude Code inside
226	the `claudebox` container. The original `/prompt`, `/health` and `/v1/*` (OpenAI compat) endpoints
227	are unchanged.
228	
229	Verified against **Claude Code 2.1.287** (`claude --help`, real `claude -p` output and the
230	`sdk-tools.d.ts` shipped in the npm package).
231	
232	## Authentication
233	
234	Every `/v2/*` request needs `Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY`.
235	If `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` is unset, `/v2/*` returns 401 for everything (fail closed) unless
236	`CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH=1`. `/health` is unauthenticated.
237	
238	## Endpoints
239	
240	| Method | Path | Description |
241	|---|---|---|
242	| GET  | `/health` | `{status, activeRequests, version, claudeVersion, authMode, activeRuns, queuedRuns, maxConcurrent, firewallMode, autoPermissionMode}`. `authMode` is `oauth` \| `api_key` \| `credentials` \| `none`. |
243	| POST | `/v2/run` | Start a run; the response **is** the SSE stream (see below). |
244	| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=N` | SSE: replay buffered events with `seq >= N` (inclusive, default 1), then follow live. Also honours the standard `Last-Event-ID` header (resumes at `id+1`) when `fromSeq` is absent. Ends immediately after replay if the run is finished. 404 if the run is unknown/expired. |
245	| GET  | `/v2/run/:runId` (alias `/v2/runs/:runId`) | Run info JSON (see `GET /v2/runs`). |
246	| POST | `/v2/abort` | `{runId}` → kills the run's whole process group (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 4 s). Queued runs are just dequeued. → `{ok, runId, found, status}` (`status: "aborting"` for a running run). 404 if unknown. |
247	| GET  | `/v2/runs` | `{runs:[RunInfo], running, queued, retained, maxConcurrent}` — active (queued + running) runs. `?all=1` includes finished runs still retained. |
248	| POST | `/v2/preview/start` | `{projectSlug, port, command?}` → PreviewStatus (200) / 400 / 409 (port busy) / 422 (cannot detect a command). |
249	| POST | `/v2/preview/stop` | `{projectSlug, port?}` → `{stopped, ...PreviewStatus}`. Also kills any *unmanaged* process listening on the port (e.g. a dev server Claude started via Bash), except running Claude runs. |
250	| GET  | `/v2/preview/status?projectSlug=&port=` | PreviewStatus. `port` optional (defaults to the managed port). |
251	| GET  | `/v2/previews` | `{previews:[PreviewStatus]}` |
252	
253	`RunInfo = {runId, projectSlug, status: queued|running|done|error|aborted, mode, model, sessionId, pid, createdAt, startedAt, endedAt, exitCode, lastSeq, firstSeq, subscribers}` (times are epoch ms).
254	
255	`PreviewStatus = {projectSlug, running, managed, listening, port, pid, kind: "process"|"static"|null, command, startedAt, exitCode, logTail: string[] (≤200 lines)}`.
256	`running = managed || listening` — `listening` comes from a TCP connect probe to `127.0.0.1:<port>` (and `::1`),
257	so a server Claude started itself is reported as running (with `managed: false`).
258	
259	Errors are JSON `{error: "message"}` with an appropriate status.
260	
261	### POST /v2/run body
262	
263	```json
264	{
265	  "runId": "uuid (optional; generated if absent)  ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$",
266	  "prompt": "string",
267	  "projectSlug": "my-app",              // ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$ ; cwd = $PROJECTS_DIR/<slug> (created if missing)
268	  "sessionId": "claude session id | null",   // → --resume
269	  "model": "opus|sonnet|haiku|<full id>",    // → --model
270	  "mode": "auto|edit|plan|ask",              // default auto
271	  "thinking": "off|normal|max",              // → env MAX_THINKING_TOKENS 0 / 8000 / 32000 (unset = CLI default)
272	  "effort": "low|medium|high|xhigh|max",     // optional → --effort
273	  "attachments": ["/workspace/uploads/<id>/<file>"],
274	  "appendSystemPrompt": "string",            // → --append-system-prompt
275	  "maxTurns": 50,                            // → --max-turns
276	  "previewPort": 4123,                       // 4100-4199 → env PORT/HOST/BASE_PATH for Claude's shell
277	  "authToken": "optional per-run token"
278	}
279	```
280	
281	* Attachments must resolve inside `$UPLOADS_DIR` or the project dir; each is appended to the
282	  prompt as `[Attached file: <path> — use Read tool]`. `--add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR` is always passed so
283	  Read works in every mode.
284	* `authToken` overrides the container env for that run: tokens starting with `sk-ant-api` are set
285	  as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (and `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` removed); anything else (e.g. `sk-ant-oat01-…`
286	  from `claude setup-token`) is set as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` removed).
287	* Child env: `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` and the server's `PORT` are removed. With `previewPort`:
288	  `PORT=<previewPort> HOST=0.0.0.0 BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/ NXEON_PREVIEW_PORT=<port>`.
289	  Always: `NXEON_PROJECT_SLUG`, `NXEON_RUN_ID`.
290	* Errors: 400 validation, 401 auth, 409 duplicate `runId` (use the events endpoint to reattach).
291	* Concurrency: at most `MAX_CONCURRENT` (default 4) runs execute; further runs wait silently in a
292	  FIFO queue (the SSE stream is open but emits nothing until the run starts; status `queued`).
293	* **Client disconnect never kills a run.** Only `/v2/abort` does. Reattach with
294	  `GET /v2/run/:runId/events?fromSeq=<lastSeenSeq+1>`. Event buffers (≤50 000 events per run) are kept
295	  for 30 minutes after completion (`RUN_RETENTION_MS`).
296	
297	## CLI invocation
298	
299	```
300	claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages \
301	       --permission-prompts none \
302	       [--model M] [--resume SID] [--max-turns N] [--effort E] [--append-system-prompt S] \
303	       --add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR  <mode flags>  -- "<prompt>"
304	```
305	
306	`stdin` is `/dev/null`; the child is spawned `detached` (own process group = pid) so abort can
307	kill the whole tree. `--permission-prompts none` (auto-deny anything that would prompt) is only passed when
308	the installed CLI advertises it in `--help` (feature detection at startup).
309	
310	### Mode mapping (verified against `claude --help` of 2.1.287)
311	
312	| mode | flags | notes |
313	|---|---|---|
314	| `auto` | `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` | Full tools. CLI 2.1.287 *does* have a `--permission-mode auto` (classifier-based), but it is gated per plan/model ("auto mode is unavailable for your plan/model") and can block actions when the classifier has no verdict — not reliable headless. Set `AUTO_PERMISSION_MODE=auto` to opt in. |
315	| `edit` | `--permission-mode acceptEdits --allowedTools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash WebFetch WebSearch TodoWrite NotebookEdit TaskCreate TaskUpdate TaskGet TaskList` | Anything else (e.g. subagents, MCP) is auto-denied. |
316	| `plan` | `--permission-mode plan` | Read-only exploration. The plan arrives as an `ExitPlanMode` `tool_use` (`input.plan`); its approval is auto-denied, so the run then ends. |
317	| `ask` | `--permission-mode dontAsk --tools Read,Glob,Grep,WebFetch,WebSearch,TodoWrite,TaskCreate,TaskUpdate,TaskGet,TaskList --allowedTools <same>` | `--tools` removes Bash/Edit/Write from the model entirely; `dontAsk` denies anything not pre-approved. |
318	
319	Thinking: `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` = `0` (off) / `8000` (normal) / `32000` (max). On adaptive-thinking
320	models the CLI treats `0` as "thinking off"; non-zero values act as a budget.
321	
322	Note: Claude Code ≥ 2.1 in `-p` mode uses **TaskCreate / TaskUpdate / TaskList** instead of TodoWrite.
323	Both are mapped to `todo` events.
324	
325	## SSE format
326	
327	```
328	id: <seq>
329	event: <type>
330	data: <json>
331	
332	```
333	
334	* `seq` starts at 1 per run and increases by 1; it is only in the `id:` line (not inside `data`).
335	* First frame is `retry: 2000`. Heartbeat comments (`: ping <ts>`) every 15 s.
336	* Response headers: `Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8`, `X-Run-Id`, `X-Run-Status`,
337	  `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.
338	* The stream is closed by the server right after `done`.
339	* `done` is **always** the last event of a run (also for spawn failures, crashes and aborts).
340	
341	### Normalized events (see `server/src/shared/protocol.ts`)
342	
343	Extra fields beyond the protocol are additive and may be ignored.
344	
345	| type | data |
346	|---|---|
347	| `init` | `{sessionId, model, tools[], cwd, permissionMode, claudeCodeVersion}` |
348	| `thinking` | `{delta}` |
349	| `text` | `{delta}` |
350	| `block_end` | `{kind: "thinking"\|"text"}` |
351	| `tool_use` | `{id, name, input, parentId?}` |
352	| `tool_result` | `{id, isError, content, parentId?}` — content stringified, truncated to 20 KiB (`…[truncated N bytes]`) |
353	| `todo` | `{todos:[{content, status, activeForm?, id?}]}` — full list each time |
354	| `usage` | `{inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, parentId?}` — **incremental**; sum them for totals |
355	| `rate_limit` | raw `rate_limit_info` (`{status, resetsAt, rateLimitType, isUsingOverage, …}`) |
356	| `result` | `{sessionId, isError, result, durationMs, numTurns, costUsd, usage:{…totals}, subtype, terminalReason?, permissionDenials?}` |
357	| `error` | `{message, code}` — code e.g. `authentication_failed`, `error_max_turns`, `process_exit`, `spawn_error` |
358	| `done` | `{exitCode, aborted?, signal?}` |
359	
360	### Raw → normalized mapping
361	
362	| raw CLI line | normalized |
363	|---|---|
364	| `{"type":"system","subtype":"init",session_id,model,tools,cwd,…}` | `init` (first only) |
365	| `system` subtypes `status`, `compact_boundary`, `hook_*`, `task_*`, … | dropped |
366	| `stream_event` `message_start` (main thread) | remembers `message.id` as *streamed*, starts usage accumulation |
367	| `stream_event` `content_block_start` (thinking/text) | opens block (initial text, if any, emitted as delta) |
368	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `thinking_delta` | `thinking {delta}` |
369	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `text_delta` | `text {delta}` |
370	| `stream_event` `content_block_delta` `input_json_delta` / `signature_delta` | dropped (tool input taken from the full assistant message) |
371	| `stream_event` `content_block_stop` of a thinking/text block | `block_end {kind}` |
372	| `stream_event` `message_delta` | merges `usage` (final `output_tokens`) |
373	| `stream_event` `message_stop` | `usage` for that message (delta vs. anything already emitted) |
374	| `stream_event` with `parent_tool_use_id` (subagent) / `ping` | dropped |
375	| `assistant` (CLI emits one per content block, same `message.id`) — `text`/`thinking` blocks | dropped if the message was streamed (dedupe); otherwise `text`/`thinking` + `block_end`. Subagent text is never emitted as main text. |
376	| `assistant` `tool_use` block | `tool_use` once per id (+`parentId` for subagents); `TodoWrite` also → `todo` |
377	| `assistant` with `error`/`is_api_error_message` (e.g. `authentication_failed`, "Not logged in") | `error {message, code}` (no text) |
378	| `assistant` usage (non-streamed messages incl. subagents, not `<synthetic>`) | `usage` (deduped per message id) |
379	| `user` `tool_result` blocks | `tool_result`; TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskList results (via `tool_use_result`) → `todo` |
380	| `rate_limit_event` | `rate_limit` |
381	| `result` | `result`; if `is_error` and no `error` was emitted yet → `error` |
382	| non-JSON / other types (`keep_alive`, `prompt_suggestion`, …) | dropped |
383	| process exit without `result` | `error {code:"process_exit", message: stderr tail}` |
384	| process exit | `done {exitCode}` |
385	
386	Example (real unauthenticated run): `init` → `error{code:"authentication_failed", message:"Not logged in · Please run /login"}` → `result{isError:true}` → `done{exitCode:1}`.
387	
388	## Preview manager
389	
390	* One preview per project. Starting again restarts it. Ports `PREVIEW_PORT_MIN..MAX` (4100-4199).
391	* Spawned as `bash -c <command>` in its own process group, cwd = project dir, env:
392	  `PORT`, `HOST=0.0.0.0`, `BASE_PATH=/preview/<slug>/`, `BROWSER=none`,
393	  `__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS=$PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOST` (default `claudebox`). Auth tokens
394	  and `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` are stripped. stdout+stderr → 200-line tail.
395	* Auto-detect (when `command` is omitted); `npm install && ` is prefixed when `node_modules` is missing:
396	  1. `package.json` `scripts.dev` + vite → `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --strictPort --base /preview/<slug>/`
397	  2. `scripts.dev` + next → `npx next dev -p $PORT -H 0.0.0.0` (app must set `basePath` from `BASE_PATH`)
398	  3. other `scripts.dev` → `npm run dev`; else `scripts.start` → `npm start`
399	  4. `index.html` in project root (or `dist/`, `build/`, `public/`, `out/`) → **built-in static server**
400	     (zero-dep, in the claudebox process) serving that dir under `/preview/<slug>/` (and also without
401	     the prefix, for strip-prefix proxies), path-traversal safe, `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
402	* Stop: SIGTERM to the group, SIGKILL after 3 s; then any other listener on that port is killed too.
403	* Vite's host check: requests are accepted for `Host: claudebox[:port]`, localhost and IPs.
404	  The app's preview proxy should therefore send `Host: claudebox:<port>` (http-proxy `changeOrigin: true`)
405	  — or the project's vite config must set `server.allowedHosts`.
406	
407	## Environment variables
408	
409	| Variable | Default | Purpose |
410	|---|---|---|
411	| `CLAUDEBOX_API_KEY` | — | Bearer token for `/v2/*` (and `/v1/*` if set). Required. |
412	| `CLAUDEBOX_ALLOW_NO_AUTH` | `0` | `1` = allow `/v2/*` without a key (dev only). |
413	| `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | — | Default Claude auth (optional; per-run `authToken` overrides). |
414	| `PORT` | `3000` | API port. |
415	| `MAX_CONCURRENT` | `4` | Max simultaneous runs (and legacy `/prompt` requests). |
416	| `PROJECTS_DIR` | `/workspace/projects` | Project root (cwd = `<dir>/<slug>`). |
417	| `UPLOADS_DIR` | `/workspace/uploads` | Allowed attachment root (mount read-only). |
418	| `PREVIEW_PORT_MIN` / `PREVIEW_PORT_MAX` | `4100` / `4199` | Allowed preview ports. |
419	| `PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOST` | `claudebox` | Passed to vite via `__VITE_ADDITIONAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. |
420	| `RUN_RETENTION_MS` | `1800000` | How long finished runs stay replayable. |
421	| `AUTO_PERMISSION_MODE` | `bypassPermissions` | Permission mode used for `mode=auto` (`auto` to use the classifier mode). |
422	| `THINKING_DISPLAY` | `summarized` | Passed as `--thinking-display` unless thinking=off (newer CLIs stream empty thinking otherwise). Empty string disables. `thinking=max` also adds `--effort high`. |
423	| `CLAUDE_BIN` | `claude` | CLI binary (tests point this at `test/mock-claude.js`). |
424	| `FIREWALL_MODE` | `open` | `open` \| `allowlist` \| `off`. |
425	| `FIREWALL_ALLOW_CIDRS` | — | Comma-separated private CIDRs to exempt in `open` mode. |
426	| `CLAUDE_SUDO` | `1` | `0` removes the claude user's sudo rights at startup. |
427	| `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` | `/home/claude/.claude` | Claude Code state (sessions for `--resume`, `.claude.json`, credentials). Mount a volume here. |
428	| `OPENAI_COMPAT` | `0` | Original OpenAI-compatible endpoints. |
429	
430	## Firewall (entrypoint, needs `--cap-add NET_ADMIN`)
431	
432	`open` mode (IPv4 `OUTPUT`): accept `lo`; accept `ESTABLISHED,RELATED` (replies to inbound
433	connections from the app on :3000 / :4100-4199 and to our own egress); accept DNS to the
434	`/etc/resolv.conf` nameservers and the default gateway; **reject** new connections to
435	`0/8 10/8 100.64/10 127/8 169.254/16 172.16/12 192.0.0/24 192.168/16 198.18/15 224/4 240/4`
436	(covers the docker network's own subnet and cloud metadata); accept everything else.
437	REJECT (icmp-admin-prohibited) is used rather than DROP so blocked tools fail fast instead of hanging.
438	IPv6: accept `lo`, established, ICMPv6; reject `fe80::/10 fc00::/7 ::ffff:0:0/96 ::1 ff00::/8`; accept `2000::/3`; reject rest.
439	
440	The entrypoint runs as root, then drops to `claude` (uid 1000) via `setpriv` with `NET_ADMIN`,
441	`NET_RAW`, `SYS_ADMIN` removed from the bounding set — so even `sudo` inside the container cannot
442	modify the firewall. `allowlist` mode is the original claudebox behaviour (`/etc/allowed-domains.txt`).

echo "exit=$?"
EOF
chmod +x raw.sh; sudo docker exec nxeon-app sh -c 'ls /app/server/node_modules | grep better'

''','''  "previewPort": 4123,                       // 4100-4199 → env PORT/HOST/BASE_PATH for Claude's shell
  "authToken": "optional per-run token",
  "autocompactTokens": 80000,                // optional; 0/absent = CLI default ("auto"). See below.
  "agents": {"code-reviewer": {"description": "…", "prompt": "…", "tools": ["Read","Grep"], "model": "sonnet"}},
  "agent": "code-reviewer"                   // optional lead agent (must be a key of `agents` when given)
}
```

* `autocompactTokens` is the context size (tokens) at which auto-compaction fires. The CLI's
  `--autocompact` takes a *window* (100k–1M) and compacts at `window − 13k`, so claudebox passes
  `--autocompact <tokens+13000>`; below 87k it passes `--autocompact 100000` plus
  `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=<tokens/1000>` (percent of the 100k window → threshold = tokens).
  The model's own context window still caps it. Valid: 0 or 10 000–987 000.
* `agents` → `--agents <json>` (custom subagents; keys `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$`, value
  `{description, prompt, tools?: string[] (omit = inherit all), model?: alias|full id|"inherit"}`).
  JSON larger than 32 KiB is written to a temp file (`--agents <path>`, allowed with `-p`) that is
  deleted when the run ends. In `edit` mode the `Agent` tool is added to `--allowedTools` when agents are passed.
* `agent` → `--agent <name>`: runs the main session *as* that agent (its prompt/tools/model).
* `--forward-subagent-text` is always passed when the CLI supports it (`FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT=0` disables):
  subagent text/thinking is forwarded as `text`/`thinking` events **tagged with `parentId`** (never merged
  into the main answer, no `block_end`).
* Manual compaction: send the prompt `/compact [instructions]` with `sessionId` (→ `--resume`).
''')

       --add-dir $UPLOADS_DIR [--autocompact W] [--agents JSON|FILE] [--agent NAME] [--forward-subagent-text] \\

| `text` | `{delta}` |''','''| `thinking` | `{delta, parentId?}` — `parentId` = forwarded subagent thinking (full block, no `block_end`) |
| `text` | `{delta, parentId?}` — `parentId` = forwarded subagent text (full block, no `block_end`) |''')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Nxeon Workspace — build images and (re)start the stack, then wait for health.
#   deploy/up.sh                # build all + up
#   deploy/up.sh --no-build     # just (re)create containers
#   deploy/up.sh app            # build + restart only the given service(s)
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
ROOT=$PWD
DC=(sudo docker compose -f "$ROOT/docker-compose.yml" --project-directory "$ROOT")

BUILD=1
SERVICES=()
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$a" in
    --no-build) BUILD=0 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,6p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) SERVICES+=("$a") ;;
  esac
done

log() { printf '\033[38;5;205m[nxeon]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '\033[31m[nxeon] %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ -f .env ] || die ".env missing (copy .env.example, fill secrets, chmod 600)"
[ "$(stat -c %a .env)" = "600" ] || { log "fixing .env permissions -> 600"; chmod 600 .env; }
[ -f Dockerfile.app ] || die "Dockerfile.app missing (app image cannot be built)"

# Bind-mount dirs must exist and be writable by uid 1000 (app + claudebox users).
for d in projects uploads db claude-home whisper-models backups; do
  mkdir -p "data/$d"
done
if [ -n "$(find data -maxdepth 2 \( -not -uid 1000 -o -not -gid 1000 \) -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  log "fixing ownership of data/ -> 1000:1000"
  sudo chown -R 1000:1000 data
fi

if [ "$BUILD" = 1 ]; then
  log "building images ${SERVICES[*]:-(all)}"
  "${DC[@]}" build --pull "${SERVICES[@]}"
fi

fi

log "starting containers"
"${DC[@]}" up -d --remove-orphans "${SERVICES[@]}"

# Wait for docker healthchecks.
wait_healthy() {
  local c=$1 timeout=${2:-180} s
  for ((i = 0; i < timeout; i += 3)); do
    s=$(sudo docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)
    case "$s" in
      healthy|running) log "$c: $s"; return 0 ;;
      unhealthy|exited|dead|missing) break ;;
    esac
    sleep 3
  done
  sudo docker logs --tail 40 "$c" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /' >&2
  die "$c did not become healthy (status: $s)"
}
wait_healthy nxeon-whisper 240
wait_healthy nxeon-claudebox 240
wait_healthy nxeon-app 180

# End-to-end through the published loopback port (what Caddy uses).
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/health >/dev/null \
  && log "app reachable on 127.0.0.1:8080" || die "app not reachable on 127.0.0.1:8080"

# Safety: nothing but 127.0.0.1:8080 may be published (docker bypasses ufw).
bad=$(sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Ports}}' | grep -E '0\.0\.0\.0:|\[::\]:|:::' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || log "WARNING: publicly published ports found: $bad"

"${DC[@]}" ps
log "done"

## Report: Compact + Agent abilities in Nxeon Workspace

Both features are built and deployed (app + claudebox). Everything was checked in a real browser with one throwaway project, which I deleted afterwards. All tests and typechecks pass:
- server: 54/54 tests, typecheck clean
- claudebox: 25/25
- web: `tsc`, `vite build`, reducer tests 8/8

The two `protocol.ts` copies are identical. I made no commits.

### Verified results

- Each usage event now carries `contextTokens`.

- New admin setting `autoCompactTokens`, default 80000 (0 = CLI default), with a field on the Settings page.

- `--forward-subagent-text` is on; the extra output is about one message per subagent turn.
- The system prompt lists the available agents with the delegate-only-when-it-saves-effort rule. The existing TOKEN BUDGET rules are unchanged.

  - A lead-agent chip in the prompt box (icon-only when on Default, to save space).
  - `@agent` autocomplete.

- I checked that no runs were active before each restart.
- The goonies-fanpage preview was running before the claudebox restart; I restarted it afterwards and it is running again.
- I took a DB backup before the migration: `/opt/nxeon-workspace/data/db/nxeon-pre-agents-1790926573699.db`.

- the `agents-qa` project
- my CLI experiment sessions and temp files in the claudebox container

- **Cost overstatement (existing bug, not fixed):** the CLI's `total_cost_usd` is cumulative per session, so every resumed run stores the running total, not its own cost. - Members can see global agents but can't turn them off for their project; only admins can toggle globals.
